description: Get counterparties list filtered by property (Sender/Recipient/ThirdPerson) via Counterparty/getCounterparties (doc 1.6). Docs require an API key, recommend caching the directory daily, and note each page tops out at 500 rows so always filter with CounterpartyProperty/FindByString.

CounterpartyProperty.description: Counterparty role: Sender, Recipient, or ThirdPerson.

FindByString.description: Search by name, phone, or EDRPOU.

name: counterparty_get_counterparties
